summary: Records ADR 0025: the effects layer's ground is written for this library (no gradient library; gradflow and MagicPattern were a benchmark only) and is ONE parametric effect, fx("gradient") — a look token (wash, sweep, fold, rise) plus shared knobs, each defaulting to the look's preset — rather than one effect per look. Aurora is retired, every shader ends in a static triangular dither, and a ground keeps its copy legible with a quiet zone of its exact base instead of a per-pixel contrast guard (amends ADR 0022, rules 5 and 6). Research and measurements: docs/webgl-gradients.md.
